Dublin, Ireland, Sept. 01, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- STERIS plc (NYSE: STE) (“STERIS” or the “Company”) announced today that it will participate in the Morgan Stanley Healthcare Conference in New York City on Tuesday, September 15, 2026. Dan Carestio, President and CEO of STERIS will present at 1:05 p.m. Eastern Time.


A simultaneous webcast and replay of the Company’s presentation will be available on STERIS’s investor relations website at[www.steris-ir.com](http://www.steris-ir.com/) .


**About STERIS**
STERIS is a leading global provider of products and services that support patient care with an emphasis on infection prevention. WE HELP OUR CUSTOMERS CREATE A HEALTHIER AND SAFER WORLD by providing innovative healthcare and life science products and services around the globe. For more information, visit www.steris.com.


**Company Contact:**
Julie Winter, Vice President, Investor Relations and Corporate Communications
Julie_Winter@steris.com
